name: @pipeworx/mcp-digitalnz

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the DigitalNZ collection by keyword. Returns matching items with ids (pass an id to record), titles, creators/sources, dates and links.

_apiKey.description: DigitalNZ API key (optional) (auto-injected by the platform).

tools.name: record
tools.description: Fetch full details for one DigitalNZ item by id — a DigitalNZ record id (the "id" field from search).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-digitalnz forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the digitalnz pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
